sub_answers.sub_question: How has the psychologist integrated trauma expertise into investigative, documentation, or rehabilitation procedures in human rights work?
sub_answers.text: Lady Edwina Grosvenor promotes a trauma-informed approach in women's prisons in the United Kingdom, integrating TIC into rehabilitation settings [d72248675s19p0]. Trauma- and violence-informed (TVIC) principles have been applied in domestic violence contexts and combined with interventions like yoga, motivational interviewing, and hospital-based violence intervention to support investigation-to-rehabilitation pathways [d72248675s13p0]. SAMHSA identifies implementation domains including screening, assessment and treatment services, policy, and cross-sector collaboration that integrate trauma expertise into investigative, documentation, and rehabilitation procedures [d72248675s3p0].
